Boiling and filters are insufficient for chemically contaminated or salty water—this could make it unsafe to drink. Stop collecting if any of these signs appear: fuel sheen, chemical smell, algae blooms, dead animals, or contamination from industrial runoff. Clarifying question: Is there a known safe source available now?
